title: Content Scripts
meta: Content scripts that read or change the pages your users visit, kept fast and private. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Content scripts built to be fast and respect privacy
overview: Content scripts are the parts of an extension that run on the websites people visit, such as highlighting text, adding a button or reading a price. We write them to match only the pages you name, to avoid slowing the site and to ask for as few permissions as possible. We handle sites that change their layout often, and we test on real pages before we hand the code over.

faq: Which websites can you work with?
Any public site that your users visit and that allows extensions to run. We do not build scripts that break a site's terms, scrape private data for resale or bypass logins.
What happens when a website changes its layout?
Scripts that depend on page structure can break. Premium adds fallback selectors to reduce that, and our maintenance service can handle repairs after later site changes.
Will it slow the pages my users visit?
We keep scripts small, run them only on matching pages and avoid heavy loops. On Premium we also check performance on a busy page and fix anything that slows it.
Does it read my users' private page content?
Only what the feature needs, and only on the sites you list. We avoid sending page content anywhere unless the feature requires it, and we explain it for your privacy policy.
